title: Can LLM Judges Catch Unsafe Clinical Actions? A Fault-Injection Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.33012v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As clinical AI agents begin to interact with electronic health records (EHRs), large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to evaluate their actions. But how reliably can these judges recognize clinically dangerous mistakes, especially when an agent appears to have completed its task successfully? We investigate this question using MedAgentBench by introducing controlled clinical errors into verified agent trajectories. The experiments include 416 faulty trajectories, eight error categories, and six open-weight LLM judges. By comparing each faulty trajectory with its correct counterpart, we measure whether judges genuinely recognize errors rather than simply flagging more actions as unsafe. The findings show that access to clinical evidence significantly improves judge reliability. translated_title: LLM裁判能否识别不安全的临床行为？一项故障注入研究
translated_abstract: 随着临床AI智能体开始与电子健康记录（EHR）交互，大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于评估这些智能体的行为。但这些裁判者能在多大程度上可靠地识别出临床上的危险错误，尤其是当智能体看起来已经成功完成任务时？我们通过在MedAgentBench中向经过验证的智能体轨迹注入受控的临床错误来研究这一问题。实验包含416条错误轨迹、八个错误类别和六个开源权重的LLM裁判。通过将每条错误轨迹与其正确的对应轨迹进行对比，我们衡量裁判者是真正识别出了错误，还是仅仅简单地将更多操作标记为不安全。研究结果表明，能否获取临床证据会显著影响裁判的可靠性。当裁判只看到最终答案时，无法区分那些不改变最终答案的错误，同时还会将56%的正确轨迹误判为不安全。（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究提出了一种故障注入评估方法，通过在MedAgentBench中向经验证的智能体轨迹注入416条受控临床错误（覆盖八个错误类别、六个开源LLM裁判），发现LLM裁判识别不安全临床行为的可靠性高度依赖于临床证据和完整轨迹的可见性——仅看最终答案时既漏检错误又误报高达56%的正确轨迹。
en_tdlr: This fault-injection study systematically evaluates LLM judges' ability to catch unsafe clinical actions by injecting controlled errors into verified MedAgentBench agent trajectories (416 faulty trajectories, 8 error categories, 6 open-weight judges), showing that judge reliability depends critically on access to clinical evidence and full trajectories, as judges seeing only final answers miss unobservable errors while falsely flagging 56% of correct ones.
